name: lunar-luxuries
description: Full-stack e-commerce store on the Organic design system. Root orchestrator — the apps live in frontend/ (Next.js storefront + admin) and backend/ (NestJS API).

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck
scripts.format: npm --prefix frontend run format && npm --prefix backend run format
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix frontend run format:check && npm --prefix backend run format:check
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check
